company.name: Sasol Delight
company.distributes: Forecourt convenience stores selling packaged snacks (Lay's, Simba, Doritos, peanuts and raisins), drinks, bakery items and daily essentials
company.channels_supplied: Sasol Delight convenience stores on Sasol forecourts across South Africa, with partner outlets such as Seattle Coffee Company and Krispy Kreme
what_they_do_well: Runs in-store promotions with major snack brands such as Simba and Doritos across its national Delight stores.
Adding partner brands such as Seattle Coffee Company and Krispy Kreme to its convenience centres since 2023.
company.fit_rationale: A national petrol station convenience chain that sells branded packaged snacks from other companies to shoppers on the go, shown by its Lay's, Simba and Doritos promotion. Store count is not stated on its website, which refers to Delight stores across the nation. It has a franchise programme and a supplier management office.

company.name: Sportsmans Warehouse
company.distributes: Sports equipment, clothing and footwear plus a supplements section with protein bars (USN Protein Bar, USN Pro Protein Bar) and a snacks category
company.channels_supplied: Its own sports stores across South Africa (store locator on its website) and its own online shop
what_they_do_well: Sells leading sports brands such as ASICS, Nike and Garmin alongside USN nutrition in stores and online.
company.fit_rationale: A national sports retailer with a supplements and snacks section that sells protein bars from other brands such as USN to health-conscious shoppers. Diablo's muesli and cereal bars and cookies suit its endurance and fitness shoppers. Store count is not stated on the pages seen.

company.name: The Vending Company
company.distributes: Snack vending with confectionery and beverages
company.channels_supplied: Offices, call centres and companies, plus independent vending operators across Africa
what_they_do_well: More than 18 years in vending, with in-house merchandisers stocking machines.
company.fit_rationale: Family-owned vending operator that runs a fully managed service with its own merchandisers stocking confectionery in workplace machines, and supports independent operators. Its website does not name the brands it stocks or its head office city. Storage: buys and holds the stock its merchandisers load, warehouse not named on its website.

contacts.job_title: Managing Director and Country Chair in Bolivia

company.name: TotalEnergies Marketing South Africa (Cafe Bonjour shops)
company.distributes: Snacks, drinks, groceries and hygiene products in its station shops, plus pastries, sandwiches and pies in Cafe Bonjour
company.channels_supplied: Cafe Bonjour shops at TotalEnergies service stations nationwide; some sites host OK Express stores
what_they_do_well: Runs one of South Africa's larger forecourt networks, with over 547 service stations as of 2025.
company.fit_rationale: Its own website says its station stores sell snacks, drinks and groceries alongside the Cafe Bonjour counter, across a network of over 547 service stations. The shop brand is run under one national banner, so it offers a central route into forecourt shops; the number of stations with a Bonjour shop and the buying model are not stated on its website.
